title: Applying the Replacement Vehicle Credit to a Replacement Purchase
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — replacement vehicle credit (customer benefit entry)**

After a paid total-loss claim, a holder of a Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda tier that carries a replacement vehicle credit may apply that credit to a replacement vehicle bought from a group store. This entry governs the credit the holder applies to a replacement purchase that stands in contracted status at a group store — a signed buyer's order awaiting delivery. A credit toward a replacement in any other status is the replacement vehicle credit amount of the waiver's tier.

## What the holder receives

- A holder whose GAP balance benefit has been paid receives the replacement vehicle credit assembled under this rule as a paid replacement vehicle credit line under the same claim number, where the tier's replacement vehicle credit amount is above 0.00.
- A waiver whose tier replacement vehicle credit amount is 0.00 receives no replacement vehicle credit.
- A waiver with no paid GAP balance line on file receives no replacement vehicle credit.

## When the credit is fixed and applied

> A replacement vehicle credit is fixed only after the claim's paid GAP balance line carries a reversal entry wherever that line paid more than 60.00 and the refunds of a Kessler Shield service contract or Kessler Care maintenance plan financed on the same deal and cancelled on or after the loss date, as paid to the lienholder, exceed the add-on refunds recorded on that line by more than 60.00.

> A replacement vehicle credit is not applied until every other waiver of the holder whose loan was reported paid off on or after the replacement purchase's contract date has left active status with no refund due on it.

Restated on the records: where the paid line exceeds 60.00 and the lienholder's add-on refunds of that kind exceed the add-on refunds recorded on the line by more than 60.00, the line must already show a reversal entry; and each of the holder's other waivers whose reported payoff date is on or after the replacement deal's contract date must show a status other than active and a refund due of 0.00.

## Tool: `apply_replacement_allowance_cdefd282`

This is the holder's own tool. The agent unlocks `apply_replacement_allowance_cdefd282` and hands it over, and the customer themselves applies the credit, assigning it to the selling store on their behalf.

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `gap_waiver_id` | Reference number of the settled GAP waiver the claim is under, as returned by the GAP waiver lookup for this holder. |
| `claim_number` | The GAP claim number exactly as it appears on the waiver's claim history, copied character for character with its prefix, hyphen and digits, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. |
| `credit_amount` | The replacement vehicle credit applied, in US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (a half cent goes up). |

**On success** a paid replacement vehicle credit line dated today is booked under the claim number, carrying over the loss and payoff figures of that claim number's GAP balance line; the waiver's benefits paid rise by the credit and the waiver stays claim settled. The confirmation reads "Replacement credit applied: line <entry id> for <amount> USD on claim <claim_number> under waiver <gap_waiver_id>; benefits paid now <total> USD." The claim number must already carry a GAP balance line on this waiver's ledger and the amount must be above 0.00; otherwise a line starting "Error:" is returned and nothing is written.
